focus_area_title: Listen to Feedback and Act on It
content_text_body:
The nature of creating an inclusive culture requires employers to build open and honest communication with employees. Keep in mind an engaged employee can become a rich source of feedback for organizational improvement. The goal is to actively seek your employees' insights and use their feedback to take action dedicated to improvements. 

### Master your listening skill
Effective listening is absolutely necessary to build a strong connection with your employees. Once you process and interpret the information they have shared, you move forward into considering how to use it. 

### Seek feedback from all employees 
Open opportunities for your team to share their thoughts. You can do this by asking questions such as: What are we missing? How can we improve things? Also, remember to include new employees in this process. This can help you to set the expectation of feedback sharing since the beginning of their employee cycle.

### Move from insights to actions
Determine how employees' recommendations contribute to organizational goals and develop an implementation plan. Make this process a collaborative effort where employees can share how they see their recommendations fitting into the team objectives and company goals. Then take action on the recommendations and provide regular feedback on progress to the team.
